source_commit_message: Add portable HF IEX data cutover authority
source_file_classes: application cutover orchestration and controller contracts
IEX acquisition, PERF1 transport, derivation, feature, target, and validation services
scientific feature, target, market-data, and retirement contracts
historical-bar provider recovery and persistent HTTPS transport
Windows composition roots retained as the Dell adapter reference
focused unit, contract, recovery, and regression tests
excluded_file_classes: raw SIP and IEX market data
Parquet and materialised feature or target datasets
caches, logs, temporary transport shards, and generated audit evidence
machine-specific controller state and active-run outputs
unrelated tracked and untracked working-tree changes

validation.focused_test_command: python -m pytest -q tests/test_hf_data_cutover_controller.py tests/test_iex_dataset_builders.py tests/test_iex_feature_builders.py tests/test_iex_market_data.py tests/test_iex_transport_shards.py tests/test_market_data_cutover.py tests/test_persistent_https.py tests/test_retirement_safety.py tests/test_historical_bar_backfill.py tests/test_atomic_json_publication.py

bootstrap: git switch hf-mac-cutover-r1 || git switch -c hf-mac-cutover-r1 --track origin/hf-mac-cutover-r1
mac_continuation.dirty_checkout_rule: Preserve all Mac-local changes before switching; do not reset, clean, or discard them.
mac_continuation.first_gate: Confirm macOS, repository identity, Python 3.11 compatibility, storage/RAM, existing data roots, and active research processes before any deletion or acquisition.
mac_continuation.portability_rule: Reuse shared scientific/data services; implement a thin POSIX lifecycle adapter instead of copying Windows process-control mechanisms.
mac_continuation.data_rule: Do not transfer raw data or credentials through GitHub and do not replay Dell deletion paths on the Mac.
